images.name: Aurora Veil
images.observation: Broad pale luminous veil across upper dungeon scene; white/cyan four-point glints and smaller snowflake-like motes. images.name: Scratch
images.observation: Thin curved white contact slash and small white sparkles; damage number above victim.

images.name: Signal Beam
images.observation: Narrow blue luminous projectile/trail tapered toward caster, bright white four-point head in direction of travel. No evidence of green or multicolor sine strands in this frame.

images.name: Smart Strike
images.observation: Bright white-yellow contact flare and fine radiating sparks between Ariados and Ponyta; thin rays around the nearer actor. The message log contains both Tackle and Smart Strike, so attribution of every streak is uncertain.
images.mapping_status: No exact existing counterpart confirmed; do not substitute unrelated moves.

images.name: Solar Beam
images.observation: Two captured phases: yellow-white glow and floating yellow motes around caster; then narrow brilliant yellow-white beam from caster to target with a bright contact star. Exact duration unknown.

images.name: Spotlight
